title: TvlReactiveImport
description: Closed import receipt of a zero-native TVL Reactive Contracts import (TRAIG-101 monitor-roles amendment 2026-10-24): a contract with no native backend_v1 latency monitor creates no production requirement, so the import route returns this receipt instead of the legacy native requirement view. Tokens, digests, refs and closed enums only; never a name or free text.

receipt_kind.description: Discriminator of the oneOf: present only on the receipt, never on the legacy native response.

contract_digest.description: Digest of the imported compiled contract.

environment_ref.description: Opaque environment token (hosted token). The customer-chosen environment name never crosses this contract; the portal resolves the name through the existing production-requirements API.

created.description: true for HTTP 201 (a new import row: first import, new digest with the same semantics, or a policy edit); false for HTTP 200 (exact replay of an existing import).

monitors.description: Every monitor of the contract as {monitor, role}. A zero-native contract has no native role.

ReactiveImportReceipt.description: Receipt of a zero-native reactive contract import.
